plan.title: SRC-AWD-003 Award Vendor A and reject empty approval remark

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units on the line to Vendor A.
Verify the full line is allocated, one of the two bidding vendors is awarded, and the proposal total is ₹1,000.
Create the award proposal from the completed allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Fill mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal so it enters the approval flow.
Verify the proposal is pending approval before the missing approver action.
